definition: The element or domain of sensuality.
notes: Keep the rendering aligned with the kāma headword and avoid narrowing the term into sexualized English or generic pleasure-language.

example_phrases.translation: the sensuality element, the ill-will element, the cruelty element
example_phrases.notes: Keeps the domain-language tied to kāma rather than to generic pleasure, and shows it in the three-element set it belongs to. MN 137, formerly cited, contains no dhātu in any form.
